tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The matter pertains to a GST dispute arising from a departmental show cause notice involving multiple issues. The Company accepted one of the observations relating to input tax credit reversal and discharged the corresponding tax liability. However, the remaining issues were contested before the GST authorities. Following adjudication, an order was passed by the department, against which the Company preferred an appeal before the Commissioner (Appeals).
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Additional Commissoner Central Goods & Service Tax
tax_litigation.status: The Company filed a writ petition before the Bombay High Court at Goa. The Hon'ble Court has directed that the matter be heard together with similar connected matters, and the case is currently pending for further proceedings.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The matter relates to an income tax demand against which the Company has filed an appeal before the Commissioner of Income-tax (Appeals). The Company also sought rectification of apparent errors in the assessment order and challenged the computation of the demand. Additionally, separate penalty proceedings have been initiated by the tax authorities under the applicable provisions of the Income-tax Act.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Assistant Commissiner of Income Tax, Central Circle, Panaji
tax_litigation.status: Pursuant to the rectification application, the tax authorities issued a rectification order revising the demand. The Company has also complied with the requirements relating to the stay application filed against recovery proceedings. The appeal before the Commissioner of Income-tax (Appeals) remains pending, and the Company is currently awaiting a hearing and adjudication of the matter. Separate penalty proceedings are also pending before the relevant authorities.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The matter pertains to observations raised by the GST department during its review of the Company's tax records. Certain observations were accepted by the Company and the corresponding tax liability was discharged. The remaining observations were disputed by the Company, for which reconciliations and supporting submissions were provided before the tax authorities. Based on the Company's submissions, some issues were proposed to be dropped, while proceedings continued on the disputed matters.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Assistant Commissioner, Circle -VII, CGST Pune Audit -II Comm'te, Goa
tax_litigation.status: The tax authorities subsequently dropped certain issues and initiated adjudication proceedings on the remaining disputed matters through a show cause notice. The Company's consultant attended the personal hearing and made submissions before the department. Thereafter, an Order-in-Original was passed by the GST authorities. Aggrieved by the order, the Company filed a writ petition before the High Court, and the matter is currently pending adjudication.
